crossRefs.note: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…
Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and…

translations.web: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
translations.bsb: Is there iniquity on my tongue? Can my mouth not discern malice?
translations.kjv: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
translations.asv: Is there injustice on my tongue? Cannot my taste discern mischievous things?
